remarks: Welcome to 30 Wingate Avenue, where over 2,400 square feet means you can finally stop using “excuse me” as your household’s official motto! Located just off Hertel Avenue in North Buffalo, this home delivers character, space, and dangerously convenient access to your next dinner reservation. Gorgeous hardwood floors set the stage, while the formal dining room gives you a proper place to host holidays, impress guests, or eat takeout on actual plates and pretend you cooked. The huge living room features a gas insert fireplace—all the cozy Buffalo winter vibes with none of the “whose turn is it to bring in firewood?” arguments. A front sitting room loaded with windows pours in natural light, so you can enjoy every available ray of sunshine during Buffalo’s annual three-minute winter appearance. The gigantic primary bedroom has room for your bed, your furniture, and the laundry chair that has quietly become a permanent member of the family. Need even more space? Head up to the finished third-floor walk-up attic with heat AND AC—perfect for an office, hobby room, or headquarters for someone who announces, “I just need five minutes of peace!” Outside, the fully fenced backyard comes with a playset, because burning off energy is best accomplished before it starts bouncing off your living room walls. Relax under the awning over the concrete patio while supervising the fun with the intensity of someone who has absolutely no intention of getting out of their chair. A detached two-car garage rounds out the package with room for vehicles, tools, and whatever you bought after saying, “We’ll definitely use this.” Big rooms. Beautiful floors. Backyard fun. Hertel nearby. This is North Buffalo living with enough elbow room to keep everybody’s elbows to themselves! Don't miss the updated high efficiency boiler system for clean heat and the high efficiency tankless hot water system for endless hot water. Showings begin Thursday 10/15 at 9 AM.
